children: Gopalkrishna Sharma and Company Secretary Darshan Shah exit following completion of the open offer and management transition

Lippi Systems has accepted the resignation of Chief Financial Officer Gopalkrishna D. Sharma, with his exit taking effect from the close of business on 21 September 2026 following a change in control and management of the company.

The company has also accepted the resignation of Company Secretary and Compliance Officer Darshan Bipinchandra Shah, with both exits coming after completion of the open offer. Lippi Systems said the departures were linked to the change in control and were not due to any dispute or disagreement with the board or management.

Sharma ceased to hold the CFO position from the close of business on 21 September. The company said the resignation was intended to facilitate the transition and handover of responsibilities to the new management after the open offer was completed.
The change places the company’s finance function under a transition period as the new management prepares to appoint a replacement CFO.
Shah has also stepped down as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer effective 21 September.

Both officials confirmed that there were no material reasons for their resignations other than the change in control. Their exits therefore coincide with the broader management transition following the open offer.
The simultaneous departure of the CFO and compliance officer means the incoming management will need to address both financial and statutory responsibilities as part of the transition.
Lippi Systems said it will take necessary steps to appoint suitable persons to the vacant positions.
The company will also complete the applicable statutory and regulatory formalities, including filings with the Registrar of Companies and stock exchanges.
The disclosures were made under Regulation 30(6) read with Para A(7) of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
The CFO vacancy comes immediately after a change in the company’s control and management, making the appointment of a new finance head part of the post-open-offer transition.
Jagdish Shivji Dholu, Managing Director, signed the company’s intimation to BSE. The company did not disclose the names or timelines for the proposed replacements.
The new appointments will determine the next phase of financial reporting, compliance and finance oversight under the company’s new management.
